 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder has to quote unit price inclusive of GST and all other applicable taxes
Quantity may vary based on our requirement
Sample has to be submitted as per our instructions before Financial bid opening
